scheme_name: International Cooperation Scheme- Capacity Building of First Time MSE Exporters
other_conditions: Micro and Small Enterprises with a valid Udyam Registration are eligible to apply
Applicant's Importer Exporter Code (IEC) must not be older than 3 years on the date of export shipment
benefits_summary: Provides financial reimbursement (up to 75% of costs) for first‑time MSE exporters on RCMC fees, export insurance premiums, and testing/quality certification, subject to specified caps.
